title: Analista De Cobrança
description: Na Agropalma, há muita coisa boa à sua espera. Então, se você é um profissional apaixonado por aprendizado e gosta de trabalhar em união, venha fazer parte do nosso time! Juntos, alcançaremos nosso objetivos. Estamos com oportunidades para pessoas com deficiência para todo o grupo. Descrição Breve do Cargo: Realizar análise de custos, apoiando na elaboração e acompanhamento de orçamentos Agroindustriais, Realizar o rastreio dos lançamentos dos custos, Apoiar a apresentação de custos por atividades, elaborando as apresentações semanais ou mensais através de ferramentas (Dashboard e Power Point), Revisar a estrutura de centros de custos, Calcular e monitorar indicadores de orçamento e produção Agroindustrial, Analisar na busca de soluções para redução de perdas e custos e maior eficiência nos processos Agroindustriais, Realizar o bloqueio de contas, realizar a consolidação das produções e valores (real/ton e vapor/ton) Apuração de custo via app web, Conciliação dos Saldos de Estoques, Atualização e Fechamento do Módulo de Estoques, Avaliação dos lançamentos nas contas de custo Habilidades e vivencias em Inventários, Executar outras atividades correlatas conforme orientação superior. Instrução: Ensino Completo em Ciências contábeis, engenharias, ou áreas relacionadas a ciências exatas. Sobre a Agropalma A Agropalma é uma empresa brasileira reconhecida em todo o mundo como referência na produção sustentável de soluções com óleo de palma. Sua trajetória começou em 1982, no município de Tailândia (PA), e sua atuação perfaz toda a cadeia produtiva – da fabricação de mudas ao óleo refinado e gorduras especiais às soluções de alto valor agregado, incluindo produtos orgânicos. Atualmente, a companhia conta com seis indústrias de extração de óleo bruto, duas refinarias e um terminal de exportação alfandegado, e emprega cerca de 5 mil colaboradores. A Agropalma também foi pioneira em implementar, há mais de 20 anos, um programa de Agricultura Familiar com palma, que beneficia hoje mais de 300 agricultores parceiros. Guiada pelo compromisso com o planeta e as pessoas, a empresa segue avançando em suas práticas para tornar a palma sustentável uma referência brasileira. Para mais informações, acesse:

title: Analista De Logística, Ats - Middle Mile
description:
About Turing:Turing is one of the world's fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world's leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.Role Overview:We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!What does day-to-day look like:You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.G. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.Requirements:Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)Analytical Skills: Good research and analytical skillsFeedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.Creative Thinking: Creative and lateral thinking abilities.Communication: Excellent communication and collaboration skills.Independence: Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.Commitment: Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.Technical Setup: Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.Preferred Qualifications:Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.Perks of Freelancing With Turing:Work in a fully remote environment.Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.Offer Details:Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_AngelesKnow amazing talent? Refer them at turing.Com/referrals, and earn money from your network.

title: Title Researcher (U.S. Real Estate)
description:
Job title: Title Researcher (U.S. Real Estate)Type of employment: Full-timeShift Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00AM – 7:00PM US Central TimeA specialized research role focused on identifying heirs, confirming ownership, and resolving title complexity for Texas property deals. You will conduct hands-on genealogy research, deep recorder-of-deeds investigations, and public records work to produce a complete, caller-ready research packet—so the sales and calling team can move cases forward without back-and-forth. Experience in genealogical research, property title investigation, probate, or U.S. public records research is highly preferred.About the CompanyA real estate acquisition firm specializing in resolving complex property issues—such as probate, liens, and title defects—to create win-win outcomes for heirs and owners of distressed Texas properties.Objectives of this RoleAccurate Identification: Produce comprehensive heirship profiles and contact pathways through professional genealogy.Title Intelligence: Execute "Track B" deep-dive investigations to surface hidden defects and opportunities invisible to standard searches.Operational Efficiency: Deliver structured, "caller-ready" research packets to the sales team to minimize back-and-forth and accelerate closing.Complex Problem Solving: Resolve bottlenecks through expert-level skip tracing and public records forensics.ResponsibilitiesGenealogy & Heir Identification: Verify owner deaths via obituaries and public records;
build family trees using Ancestry.Com and alternative indicators (deed dates, court records).Title Chain Research (Track A & B): Conduct full Title Intelligence Profile (TIP) investigations. Trace ownership via grantor/grantee and legal descriptions, analyze all recorded instruments, and flag breaks in chain or unreleased liens.Public Records Investigation: Scour probate, tax, divorce, bankruptcy (PACER), and Secretary of State records to validate entity and individual status.Advanced Skip Tracing: Locate hard-to-find heirs using social media and non-standard digital forensics;
verify all data againstthe heir profile.CRM Documentation & Curative Support: Record structured findings in Podio;
identify required curative instruments (e.G., Affidavits of Heirship) and outline resolution paths.Required Skills and QualificationsGenealogy Expertise: Professional experience building family trees and navigating birth/death/marriage/divorce records.Advanced Title Search: Proven ability to read and interpret complex recorded documents and identify hidden title defects.Public Records Proficiency: Mastery of county recorder portals, probate courts, and federal (PACER) databases.Analytical Documentation: Ability to summarize complex legal/familial findings into concise, actionable English notes.Technical Tools: High proficiency in Ancestry.Com and skip tracing platforms (TLO, Batch, or similar).Preferred Skills and QualificationsPrior experience in U.S. Title Curative or Texas-specific property research.Experience with Podio CRM.Background in estate law, probate, or professional heir-hunting.Bilingual (English/Spanish) is a plus.

title: Senior Manager, Ocean Policy
description:
Senior Manager, Ocean PolicyConservation International protects nature for the benefit of humanity. Through science, policy, fieldwork, and finance, we spotlight and secure the most important places in nature for the climate, biodiversity, and for people. With offices in 30 countries and projects in more than 100 countries, Conservation International partners with governments, companies, civil society, Indigenous peoples, and local communities to help people and nature thrive together.POSITION SUMMARYThis position is open for consideration in the following locations in the Americas, with preference for candidates based in time zones that can accommodate calls with colleagues in Europe and Africa: Arlington-US, Brazil(remote), Colombia, Costa Rica, Ecuador, Guyana, Mexico, Suriname, PeruOver the last 10 years, CI has developed a comprehensive Blue Climate program spanning over 20 countries dedicated to identifying and addressing science and policy priorities for oceans and climate globally. The Blue Climate program within the Center for Oceans at CI works closely with our field programs across the Americas, Asia-Pacific and Africa to design and implement innovative approaches to (1) implement nature-based climate adaptation solutions that improve coastal and marine communities’ livelihoods and resilience while also conserving ecosystems and biodiversity;
and (2) conserve and restore coastal blue carbon ecosystems (mangroves, salt marshes, and seagrass meadows) for climate change mitigation. The Blue Climate program also has key leadership roles in advancing climate mitigation and adaptation priorities into national and regional coastal management and science through the International Blue Carbon Institute, Blue Carbon Initiative, the International Partnership for Blue Carbon, the Global Mangrove Alliance and the Global Green-Gray Community of Practice, and policy with the Center for Policy and Incentives.Under the supervision of the Director, Ocean Policy, the Senior Manager, Ocean Policy, is a self-motivated, creative team member integral to the long-term growth and success of CI’s Blue Climate program and Ocean Policy team. The Senior Manager, Ocean Policy will support the development, implementation and management of strategic international policy‑based approaches and programs to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, climate mitigation, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon ecosystems and ocean‑climate integration. Together with the Director, Ocean Policy, they will work with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure alignment with CI’s larger international and national policy programs and priorities, including providing technical inputs and guidance on ocean‑climate issues. The position will also work closely with teams across CI including other programs within the Center for Oceans and the Moore Center for Science and Solutions to ensure alignment and integration of ocean policy priorities with all related CI programs and topic areas, including biodiversity, finance, and community fisheries.RESPONSIBILITIESInternational Ocean Policy- Manage strategic policy initiatives to achieve CI’s Ocean Policy goals spanning coastal resilience, green‑gray infrastructure, blue carbon, and other ocean‑climate areas which integrate and align international and national policy goals.- Work closely with CI’s Center for Policy and Incentives to ensure ocean‑climate strategies and approaches are aligned with international and national policy programs and priorities.- Play a key role in project development, fundraising, implementation, communications, and broader capacity building for the Ocean Policy program.- Contribute to the drafting and revision of CI ocean policy positions, policy briefs, guidance documents, and other technical resources.- Play a key role in representing the Center for Oceans within the CI delegation to international policy meetings related to climate, biodiversity, and oceans, such as the UNFCCC climate COP and intersessional meetings. Additionally, support CI’s strategic engagement in these spaces (e.G., side events, meetings with countries and partners).- Support the development and management of relationships and partnerships title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.Senior Legal CounselMain responsibilities- Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.- Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.- Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.- Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.- Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.- Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.- Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.- Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.- Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.Required qualifications- Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.- Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.- Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English;
ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.- Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.Preferred experience- Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors.- Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions, especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.- Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties, state‑owned entities, or other regulated counterparties.- Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance.- Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.What success looks like in this role- Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.- Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.- Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.- Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities;
everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.Please note that according to Wärtsilä policy, voluntary consent for a security check may be required from candidates being considered for this position, depending on the applicable country.Wärtsilä is a global leader in innovative technologies and lifecycle solutions for the marine and energy markets. Our team of 18,300 professionals, in more than 230 locations in 77 countries, shape the decarbonisation transformation of our industries across the globe. Read more on

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Estratégia De Redes Sociais - Influência E Produção | Marketing Produtos...
description:
Descrição da vagaSobre a área:A área é responsável pela gestão estratégica das redes sociais das marcas do Globoplay e de canais de variedades, entretenimento e esportivos do ecossistema Globo. Atua com as outras áreas de Marketing na conceituação e execução de planos de lançamento e sustentação dos projetos e campanhas alinhado aos objetivos de negócio de cada frente. Faz a gestão da relevância da presença das marcas nas plataformas com foco em engajamento com o consumidor, rentabilização e complementariedade de narrativas e públicos. Tem objetivo de criar estratégias que posicionem a Globo frente aos concorrentes dos territórios de Entretenimento, Esporte, Notícias e Streaming de forma inovadora, consistente e alinhado às mudanças de comportamento de consumo.Diversidade:Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.Modelo de trabalho:Híbrido: Rio de Janeiro, RJ.Responsabilidades e atribuiçõesComo será seu dia a dia:- Coordenar as frentes de Influência e Produção da área de Redes Sociais de Produtos Digitais;
- Liderar as campanhas de marketing de influência do Globoplay e dos canais esportivos e não esportivos da Globo;
- Atuar em parceria com outras lideranças na concepção, planejamento e gestão de projetos de lançamento e sustentação das marcas;
- Gerenciar o time de Produção, responsável por toda a cadeia de execução: pré-produção, atuação in loco e pós-produção;
- Garantir a entrega de conteúdos originais e coberturas de grandes eventos para os perfis do ecossistema;
- Liderar a gestão orçamentária das campanhas de influência e dos projetos de produção.Requisitos e qualificaçõesDo que você precisa:- Experiência em Marketing de Influência, com sólido conhecimento sobre a creator economy e o mercado de influenciadores, atuando estrategicamente na conexão entre marcas e creators;
- Vivência em planejamento e acompanhamento de produções de conteúdo audiovisual, com domínio de todas as etapas do processo, desde concepção criativa até execução e entrega final;
- Conhecimento em desenvolvimento de storytelling, sendo capaz de transformar ideias, informações e dados em narrativas estratégicas, relevantes e criativas para diferentes plataformas;
- Experiência na análisede métricas de redes sociais, utilizando dados e indicadores de performance para embasar tomadas de decisão estratégicas e otimização de resultados;
- Vivência na criação e proposição de soluções criativas, alinhadas às linguagens, tendências e referências das redes sociais, garantindo relevância cultural e engajamento;
- Perfil constantemente atento a novidades, insights e movimentos do mercado, contribuindo para o fortalecimento de um posicionamento de marca ousado, inovador e conectado às transformações digitais;
- Experiência na elaboração de apresentações estratégicas em PowerPoint, com clareza narrativa, organização de informações e foco em objetivos de negócio;
- Conhecimento e uso do Pacote Office, com destaque para Excel, aplicado à análise, organização e acompanhamento de dados e indicadores;
- Vivência na gestão de orçamentos de campanhas e produções, assegurando controle financeiro, eficiência de custos e otimização de recursos;
- Experiência em liderança e desenvolvimento de pessoas, com atuação direta na gestão, engajamento e evolução de equipes;
- Atuação colaborativa, com perfil inquieto, curioso e antenado às constantes transformações do mercado, contribuindo ativamente em ambientes multidisciplinares;
- Comunicação em inglês em nível avançado, com capacidade de conduzir interações profissionais, apresentações e análises no idioma.Conhecimentos que te destacam:- Conhecimento e atuação prévia com agências de influenciadores do mercado.Informações adicionaisPor que vir para Globo:Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos. Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação. A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles. Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.Os seus dados pessoais serão utilizados para fins de seleção de candidatos para preenchimento das vagas abertas na Globo. Os dados pessoais coletados durante o processo seletivo dos candidatos que não forem admitidos neste momento poderão ser mantidos nos bancos de dados para consideração em futuros processos seletivos. Todos os dados coletados serão tratados segundo rígidos padrões de segurança da informação e em total respeito às leis de privacidade aplicáveis, incluindo a Lei 13.709/18, e nos termos de nossa política de privacidade, disponível no link: prosseguir você está ciente e de acordo para realização de sua candidatura nestes termos.#J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation
description:
Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - OptimisationJoin or sign in to find your next job

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation

1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

Join to apply for the Embedded Linux Senior Software Engineer - Optimisation role at Canonical

Work across the full Linux stack from kernel through GUI to optimise Ubuntu, the world's most widely used Linux desktop and server, for the latest silicon.

The role is a fast-paced, problem-solving role that's challenging yet very exciting. The right candidate must be resourceful, articulate, and able to deliver on a wide variety of solutions across PC and IoT technologies. Our teams partner with specialist engineers from major silicon companies to integrate next-generation features and performance enhancements for upcoming hardware.

Location: This is a Globally remote role

What your day will look like

  • Design and implement the best Ubuntu integration for the latest IoT and server-class hardware platforms and software stacks
  • Work with partners to deliver a delightful, optimised, first class Ubuntu experience on their platforms
  • Take a holistic approach to the Ubuntu experience on partner platforms with inputs on technical plans, testing strategy, quality metrics
  • Participate as technical lead on complex customer engagements involving complete system architectures from cloud to edge
  • Help our customers integrate their apps, SDKs, build device OS images, optimize applications with Ubuntu Core, Desktop and Server
  • Work with the most advanced operating systems and application technologies available in the enterprise world.

Joining Canonical, you will partner with bright minds from all over the world, and work with an exciting set of new technologies in a fast growing company with a truly unique and ambitious vision to build a better platform with free software. You will work with customers on exciting IoT and server platforms and technologies, built to support different verticals: from robots to data centers, from telco to retail.

What we are looking for in you

  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You have a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, STEM or similar
  • You have experience with Linux packaging (Debian, RPM, Yocto)
  • You have experience working with open source communities and licences
  • You have experience working with C, C++
  • You can work in a globally distributed team through self-discipline and self-motivation.

Additional Skills That You Might Also Bring

  • Experience with graphics stacks
  • Good understanding of networking - TCP/IP, DHCP, HTTP/REST
  • Basic understanding of security best practices in IoT or server environments
  • Good communication skills, ideally public speaking experience
  • IoT / Embedded experience – from board and SoC, BMCs, bootloaders and firmware to OS, through apps and services
  • Some experience with Docker/OCI containers/K8s

What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we've been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental Leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at 'sprints'
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events

About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm that is at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open source projects and the platform for AI, IoT and the cloud, we are changing the world on a daily basis. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence - in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do.

Canonical has been a remote-first company since its inception in 2004. Work at Canonical is a step into the future, and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game. Canonical provides a unique window into the world of 21st-century digital business.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

description:
Já pensou em redirecionar sua carreira ou aprender uma nova profissão? Agora imagine só, poder fazer isso sendo parceiro de uma empresa que, há quase 200 anos, ajuda as pessoas a planejar um futuro financeiro mais tranquilo. Aqui na MAG, nossos corretores parceiros são chamados de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira . E se você tem tino comercial, gosta de se relacionar com pessoas, tem perfil empreendedor e deseja trabalhar com o forte propósito de prover soluções financeiras individuais nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros, nosso Programa para Formação de Especialistas em Proteção Financeira é a oportunidade ideal para você!

Vantagens de se tornar Especialistas em Proteção Financeira parceiro da MAG Seguros
  • Além de toda estrutura de suporte, treinamento e acompanhamento, poderemos apoiá-lo financeiramente na fase inicial de constituição de seu negócio, mediante o atingimento de critérios mínimos de produtividade.
  • Subsídios de até 70% para adquirir produtos como plano de saúde, de telefonia móvel, seguros de vida, notebook e smartphone, mediante elegibilidade ao nosso Programa de Fidelidade
  • Comissionamento vitalício sobre grande parte das coberturas comercializadas, ou seja, a comissão é do corretor pelo tempo em que o contrato do cliente estiver ativo, permitindo ganhos ilimitados.
  • Atuação presencial, com relacionamento multicanal, que pode ser realizado via unidades de vendas, telefone, WhatsApp, e-mail e chat, além de portal exclusivo para corretores.
  • Campanhas de vendas periódicas, que premiam os vencedores, além do reconhecimento e distinção, com incríveis viagens de turismo ou de desenvolvimento. Acesse vida.mag.com.br/mag-365.
  • Conversão das vendas em pontos que podem ser trocados por mais de 50 mil itens disponíveis em um catálogo virtual.
Responsabilidades e atribuições

Você atuará como profissional autônomo com as seguintes atribuições:

  • Inicialmente, se dedicará exclusivamente ao curso preparatório da MAG Universidade para obtenção da habilitação técnico profissional junto a Susep.

Após a conquista da Habilitação:

  • Identificará potenciais clientes para abordar, utilizando sua Rede de Relacionamento para agendamento de entrevistas de vendas e solicitação de indicações;
  • Fará telemarketing ativo para agendar entrevistas de vendas;
  • Realizará as entrevistas de vendas, identificando as necessidades de proteção financeira do prospect e ofertando as soluções mais adequadas a cada perfil;
  • Gerenciará a sua carteira de clientes com foco na sustentabilidade financeira do seu negócio.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Aptidão para vendas;
  • Amplo círculo social (network/ rede de relacionamento);
  • Perfil ativo nas redes sociais;
Você se diferenciará, se possuir:
  • Experiência como profissional autônomo, liberal ou empreendedor;
  • Experiência com venda consultiva e rotina de vendas externas.
Informações adicionais PESSOAS BEM-SUCEDIDAS NESSA PROFISSÃO
  • São aguerridas, motivadas, resilientes e persistentes, dedicando à construção do sucesso de seu próprio negócio;
  • Identificam-se com o propósito de despertar nas pessoas o desejo e a necessidade de assegurar o próprio futuro e o das pessoas que amam;
  • Possuem ampla rede de relacionamento, frequentam grupos sociais ligados a esporte, religião, hobbies, culinária, educação, negócios ou qualquer outro tema que permita estar em contato frequente com diferentes pessoas, ampliando o círculo social;
  • Possuem como prioridades o sucesso profissional e os ganhos financeiros, independente de regime de contratação de trabalho;
  • Têm disponibilidade para atuar conforme agenda do cliente, possuindo flexibilidade na rotina de trabalho, para atendimento além dos horários convencionais;

title: Coordenador (a) de Tesouraria
description:
No Grupo Raiz Educação , acreditamos que uma tesouraria estruturada é essencial para garantir liquidez, previsibilidade e segurança financeira em uma operação em constante crescimento. Controles consistentes, boa capacidade analítica e decisões orientadas por dados fortalecem a sustentabilidade do negócio e apoiam a estratégia do Grupo.

Se você tem experiência em tesouraria, perfil analítico, olhar atento aos detalhes e habilidade para negociar com instituições financeiras, essa oportunidade pode ser para você!

Responsabilidades e atribuições
  • Gerenciar o fluxo de caixa, acompanhando entradas e saídas, projetando necessidades de liquidez e propondo estratégias para otimização financeira.
  • Liderar a equipe de Tesouraria, acompanhando a execução das rotinas, promovendo desenvolvimento do time e garantindo alinhamento com as diretrizes e prioridades da área.
  • Negociar com instituições financeiras para obtenção de linhas de crédito e financiamentos, conforme as necessidades operacionais do Grupo.
  • Garantir a acuracidade das conciliações bancárias, assegurando aderência entre os registros do sistema e os extratos bancários.
  • Supervisionar registros e baixas de pagamentos, incluindo boletos, cartões e PIX.
  • Gerir dívidas, empréstimos e financiamentos, buscando as melhores condições e alinhamento às metas financeiras da companhia.
  • Monitorar despesas e elaborar relatórios financeiros, sinalizando riscos, oportunidades e necessidades de ajuste orçamentário.
  • Analisar dados financeiros e de fluxo de caixa por meio de indicadores e métricas que apoiem decisões estratégicas e operacionais.
Requisitos e qualificações
  • Ensino superior completo em Administração, Economia, Engenharia de Produção ou áreas correlatas.
  • Sólida experiência em rotinas de tesouraria, gestão financeira e nas atividades relacionadas à função.
  • Experiência com liderança de equipe, gestão de prioridades e acompanhamento de entregas.
  • Vivência com Totvs RM, especialmente em gestão de processos financeiros e integração com ferramentas bancárias.

Pioneira em oferecer serviços como aluguel mensal para pessoa física, Wi‑Fi no carro, pré‑pagamento e ChatBot nas redes sociais, foi a primeira locadora do país a ir além do carro, ajudando a revolucionar o setor de locação no Brasil. title: Senior Legal Counsel
description:
Wärtsilä is a world leader in marine technology and leading the industry’s transformation towards a decarbonised and sustainable future. With the world’s widest portfolio and service network, we – Wärtsilians - deliver efficient, safe and sustainable integrated products and solutions to enhance the business of our customers. The opportunities presented through digitalisation and new technologies are offering a new era of shipping. Did you know that shipping is the world’s most efficient mode of transportation and that 88% of the world’s trade is carried by sea? We want to change the course towards an interconnected and cleaner maritime future and are constantly on the lookout for future‑oriented talent to join our team and to work towards enabling sustainable societies through innovation in technology and services‑together. Are you ready to jump onboard?

Would you like to be part of Wärtsilä’s journey to decarbonise the maritime industry? Marine Legal & Compliance supports Wärtsila’s Marine businesses by enabling growth, safeguarding the business, and upholding trust. The team works across the full contract lifecycle and helps the business balance commercial opportunity with legal, compliance, financial, operational, and reputational risk. This role will serve as a senior regional legal partner for Latin America, with a strong focus on commercial contracting, compliance‑sensitive transactions, dispute prevention and handling, and business partnering across sales, delivery, lifecycle, and selected strategic initiatives.

Senior Legal Counsel Main responsibilities
  • Draft, review, structure, and negotiate complex commercial agreements in support of Marine businesses, including project sales, equipment delivery, lifecycle/service agreements, framework agreements, amendments, NDAs, notices, and other legal documentation.
  • Provide practical, solutions‑oriented legal advice to business stakeholders in Latin America across the full contract lifecycle, including pre‑bid, bid, negotiation, execution, delivery, claims, and disputes.
  • Act as the primary legal business partner for matters involving customers and opportunities in Latin America.
  • Support negotiation strategy and escalation analysis under Marine Legal & Compliance policies, including use of contract templates, GTCs, approval matrices, and deviation processes.
  • Partner closely with Sales, Project Delivery, lifecycle/service teams, business control, risk, compliance, trade compliance, safety, cyber, data privacy, sourcing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure that legal and compliance considerations are addressed in commercial activities.
  • Advise on cross‑border and public‑sector / state‑owned‑customer transactions in the region, including risk allocation, liability, subcontracting, assignment, delivery, compliance, and procurement‑related issues.
  • Support compliance and integrity initiatives relevant to the region, including anti‑corruption, Know Your Business Partner / third‑party risk, Code of Conduct, and related awareness‑building.
  • Contribute to legal training, template development, continuous improvement, and simplification of contracting processes, and help business teams understand when and how to involve Marine Legal & Compliance.
  • Provide legal support in strategic areas relevant to Marine’s current priorities, including decarbonisation, new fuels, regulatory implementation, safety, and selected digital/cyber/data issues as they arise in regional transactions.
Required qualifications
  • Qualified to practice law in Brazil or, alternatively, in the relevant jurisdiction of hire.
  • Strong post‑graduation legal experience as a practising attorney at a reputable law firm, and preferably as in‑house counsel.
  • Strong experience drafting and negotiating sophisticated commercial agreements in Portuguese and English ; ability to also draft and negotiate in Spanish is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrated ability to advise business stakeholders independently, negotiate high‑complexity matters, and balance legal protection with commercial practicality.
Preferred experience
  • Experience supporting marine, industrial equipment, lifecycle/service, energy, oil & gas, infrastructure, or other technically complex B2B sectors .
  • Experience with Latin American civil‑law jurisdictions , especially Brazil and broader South/Central America.
  • Experience with public procurement / government‑related counterparties , state‑owned entities , or other regulated counterparties.
  • Familiarity with anti‑corruption, third‑party risk / KYBP, data/privacy, trade compliance, cyber/security‑related clauses, and policy‑based contract governance .
  • Experience delivering internal training, building playbooks/templates, and working in a policy‑driven contracting environment.
What success looks like in this role
  • Trusted legal partner to Marine stakeholders in Latin America.
  • Strong, business‑facing negotiator who can lead matters independently in Portuguese and English, and preferably Spanish.
  • Able to identify the big picture quickly, understand the contract and the business need, assess legal/commercial/compliance risk, involve the right stakeholders, and move matters forward pragmatically.
  • Collaborative, commercially minded, solution‑oriented, and comfortable operating in a matrixed global organization.

You will join a highly capable global legal and compliance team that plays a central role in supporting Wärtsilä Marine’s commercial, compliance, and decarbonisation agenda. Marine Legal & Compliance works at the intersection of contracting, technology, regulation, safety, and strategic business partnering, with opportunities to contribute meaningfully to both regional business execution and wider global initiatives.

At Wärtsilä we value, respect and embrace all our differences, and are committed to diversity, inclusion and equal employment opportunities; everyone can be their true self and succeed based on their job‑relevant merits and abilities.

description:
SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrófica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04/03/1966, 40.103 de 17/05/1962 e 8.911, de 30/07/1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Efetuar exames médicos, emitir diagnósticos, prescrever medicamentos, realizar outras formas de tratamento; tirar dúvidas e orientar pacientes em situações que requerem mais atenção.

Job Description

The Vice President Business Development individually drives market position and achievement of business outcomes through the Demand and Account Management/Commercial Operations Core Process. This position is a senior level, core sales position within the company responsible for new business/clients as well as managing/leveraging existing accounts. The Vice President Business Development drives results through individual and collective team sales efforts. The position is responsible for leveraging collaboration with internal teams such as marketing, engineering/survey, and product development and technology groups in order to drive service and business outcomes. The Vice President Business Development also contributes to strategic initiatives and planning through an extensive knowledge of market conditions within their assigned specific location or group of locations, country or group of countries, market sector, and/or product(s).

What You Will Do:
  • Execute and drive sales strategies in the assigned area of responsibility and meet or exceed sales and revenue targets with a focus on the marine area.
  • Support the Product & Digital Solution Development, Survey & Certification, Engineering Delivery, and Rule Development Core Processes as needed to achieve organizational business outcomes.
  • Develop and maintain key client relationships with a focus on maintaining current work and expanding new business opportunities and prospect for new clients and business opportunities within your assigned responsibility in marine sector.
  • Lead the development of visit plans for assigned clients and area of responsibility, to include organizing client meetings for ABS senior management.
  • Execute the Demand and Account Management / Commercial Operations Core Process as appropriate within the assigned area of responsibility.
  • Maintains awareness of the overall ABS service portfolio and promote services/products when appropriate, ensuring peers and teams outside your core responsibility are aware of potential opportunities and needed action.
  • Provide strategic insight within the assigned area or responsibility related to future business initiatives, market drivers, and competitor activities for inclusion in business planning.
  • Work with organizational teams to develop capture strategies, proposals and pricing as appropriate.
  • Work with technical staff and other internal teams as needed to meet customer needs.
  • Attend industry events and conferences, and provide feedback and information on market and creative trends.
  • Identify opportunities for marketing campaigns within the area of responsibility that will lead to increased sales.
  • Submit reports as needed and ensure data is accurately entered and managed within the company’s CRM.
  • Forecast sales targets and track activity on accounts to meet these targets.
What You Will Need:

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in business or in an engineering technical field is required.
  • MBA or engineering postgraduate degree is preferred.
  • Over 20 years of experience in marine sector.
  • Typically 7 or more years of experience in the assigned area of responsibility or market sector is required.
  • International experience, either as an expatriate or working with international projects and teams, is required.
  • Previous experience in business development or sales in a technical and diverse product environment is preferred.
Knowledge, Skills, And Abilities
  • Demonstrated acumen for sales, business development, and account management with experience in meeting and/or exceeding sales targets preferred.
  • Demonstrated proficiency in developing strategic customer relationships.
  • Strong leadership presence and the ability to quickly establish and build credibility and relationships, externally as well as internally to ABS.
  • Excellent business judgment, including the ability to assess the reasonableness and likelihood of success of various business scenarios.
  • Demonstrated technical acumen related to the product or area of responsibility.
  • A self-starter with a demonstrated desire achieve goals and as well as a collaborative personality who effectively works with teams and individuals to achieve organizational business outcomes.
Reporting Relationships:

Reports directly to the Senior Vice President.

We set out more than 160 years ago to promote the security of life and property at sea and preserve the natural environment. Today, we remain true to our mission and continue to support organizations facing a rapidly evolving seascape of challenging regulations and new technologies. Through it all, we are anchored by a vision and mission that help our clients find clarity in uncertain times. ABS is a global leader in marine and offshore classification and other innovative safety, quality, and environmental services. We’re at the forefront of supporting the global energy transition at sea, the application of remote and autonomous marine systems, cutting‑edge technical solutions, and many more exciting advancements. Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, aWLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento deconcessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operaçõesEquipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR).

No segmento doagronegócio , por meio de suas controladasFartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% daCHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce aEkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

A holding do grupo está localizada no Rio de Janeiro e conta com uma filial corporativa em Contagem/MG.

  • Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas.

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO
  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesse nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista. Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, então não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo! Venha fazer parte da PRIO.

Sobre a PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único. Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório sem paredes que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Head of Commercial Partnerships
description:
Head of Commercial Partnerships

Department: Commercial & Marketing

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (”FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work together with FIFA HQ in Zurich, to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup™ (”FWWC”).

The Head of Commercial Partnerships has responsibility, under the leadership of FIFA’s Director Commercial Partnerships and the operational guidance of the Brazil Entity Chief Operations Officers, for the successful implementation and coordination of the commercial revenue programs for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™.

This cross-functional position plays a critical role in planning, managing and implementing Host Country commercial revenues activities related to sponsorship sales, partnership management & partner rights delivery and commercial operations.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  • In close cooperation with FIFA’s Commercial Partnerships department, manage the day-to-day implementation plans in relation to the Tournament’s commercial partnerships programs, as well as manage relevant local sales agencies and service providers.
  • Working with Relevant Department Heads from FIFA, lead the Host Country commercial partnerships staff across sponsorship sales, partnership management and partner rights delivery.
  • Work with FIFA Commercial Partnerships Sub-Division and Host Country to shape integrated plans and strategies, including relevant sales and operational plans.
  • Working closely with the FIFA Partnership Sales team, ensure the effective delivery of the Tournament’s sponsorship sales with a focus on regional sponsorships in host country.
  • Identify and develop strong relationships with potential key sponsors and agencies in the host country and wider region, proactively lead on contract negotiations, and contribute to maintaining strong and effective relationships with sponsors.
  • Manage the regional sponsorship sales process in accordance with the defined timetable and priorities and negotiate agreements across relevant markets.
  • In close alignment with FIFA Partnership Management team, contribute to building strong and successful relationships with FIFA partners.
  • Working closely with FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and with the support of a local team, deliver all commercial operations as per the rights granted to Commercial Partners for the competition and competition-related events and sites.
  • In close collaboration with the FIFA Partner Rights Delivery team in Zurich and Brazil, ensure successful implementation of the public Food & Beverage (F&B) concessions programme across all stadiums.
  • Manage and support a talented team of individuals, located at Brazil HQ across all commercial partnerships and licensing projects.
YOUR PROFILE
  • 10+ years of international commercial experience in sport
  • Proven experience within global sports / Rights Holder environment
  • Proven track record managing major commercial programs across sponsorship sales, partnership management and commercial operations
  • Proven and successful track record in opening, negotiating and closing significant multi-year, multi-million sponsorship deals
  • Knowledge of commercial operations in major event settings and/or the sports industry
  • Experienced negotiator and ability to manage complex and lengthy processes
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build and maintain effective working relationships across multiple teams and at varying levels
  • Experience and knowledge of local markets and culture
  • Ability to work in a matrixed environment
  • Ability to hire, develop, coach, appraise and retain qualified employees
  • Experience of managing multi-disciplined teams across a variety of business areas
  • Capacity to make key decisions for the business through critical problem-solving skills and an ability to use sound judgement
  • Creative and strategic thinker from a diverse background
  • Proficient in preparing and managing budgets
  • Proven organisational skills with excellent attention to detail, particularly under pressure
  • Solid operational and strategic marketing knowledge/experience
  • Operational knowledge and experience in major international events, preferably sports events
  • Passion for sport

Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Ability to re-locate to Rio de Janeiro.

O Guanabara também inovou no calendário varejista do estado do Rio de Janeiro e criou campanhas promocionais como: Semana da Beleza, Semana da Limpeza, Guanababy, Black Fraldas e o tradicional Aniversário Guanabara!

Join Howard University and thrive with us! Chief of Staff

The Chief of Staff serves as the Dean’s senior strategic advisor and operational partner, providing executive-level leadership support, institutional coordination, and oversight of school-wide strategic initiatives. This role is responsible for translating the Dean’s vision into actionable priorities, ensuring alignment across academic, administrative, and operational functions, and supporting decision‑making at the highest level of the School.

This position is designed as a future‑state leadership role focused on strategy, governance, and executive coordination. It does not manage day‑to‑day program execution, event planning, or operational delivery functions, which are carried out within academic and administrative units.

The Chief of Staff reports directly to the Dean of the School of Communications.

Supervisory Authority

The Chief of Staff may provide functional and strategic oversight of administrative staff or project teams as assigned by the Dean. Supervisory authority, when delegated, is focused on initiative coordination, performance alignment, and accountability, rather than day‑to‑day task supervision. This role does not supervise academic programs.

Nature and Scope

The Chief of Staff operates at the executive level within the School of Communications and supports the Dean through strategic coordination, leadership advising, and institutional alignment. The role requires independent judgment, discretion, and a high level of professional integrity. The scope of the position is strategic and advisory, rather than programmatic or operational.

Key Responsibilities Executive Strategy & Leadership Support
  • Serve as the Dean’s principal strategic advisor on institutional priorities, organizational effectiveness, and operational planning.

Institutional Coordination & Governance
  • Coordinate cross‑functional efforts among academic leadership, administrative units, and external stakeholders to ensure alignment with the School’s mission and objectives.
  • Represent the Dean, as appropriate, in senior‑level meetings, working groups, and institutional forums.
  • Monitor progress on key initiatives and elevate risks, dependencies, and decision points to the Dean.
Operational Oversight (Strategic Level)
  • Provide high‑level oversight of administrative and operational workflows to ensure efficiency, accountability, and alignment with institutional standards.
  • Partner with senior administrators to identify opportunities for process improvement and organizational alignment.
  • Support clarity in leadership roles, responsibilities, and decision‑making authority.
Communications & Special Projects
  • Lead or support high‑priority initiatives and special projects at the direction of the Dean.
  • Draft, review, and coordinate executive communications, reports, and institutional correspondence.
  • Ensure consistency and clarity in messaging across leadership initiatives.
Core Competencies
  • Strategic leadership and sound judgment

  • Organizational effectiveness and process improvement
  • Stakeholder engagement and relationship management
  • Analytical thinking and problem‑solving
  • Project and initiative oversight
  • Professional discretion and integrity
Minimum Qualifications

Nossa visão é otimizar toda a cadeia de suprimentos e operações para este segmento do varejo, que representa um mercado de R$250Bi somente no Brasil.

A Clubbi foi fundada em 2020 e já chamou atenção de alguns dos melhores fundos de VC do Brasil e do Vale do Silício: Valor Capital, OneVC, Canary, Better Tomorrow Ventures.

Nossa Cultura e Valores

Nossa missão é fortalecer os pequenos varejistas como os maiores protagonistas do comércio na América Latina.

A gente acredita que por meio da digitalização de toda a cadeia de suprimentos e das operações do varejo podemos nos transformar no canal mais eficiente de distribuição para estes produtos.

Para ter sucesso neste objetivo, desenvolvemos uma cultura única e especial:

  • Nos desprendemos da nossa realidade para vestir a camisa pelo nosso cliente;
  • Desenvolvemos um time fora da curva;
  • Não temos medo de errar, desde que isso nos ensine alguma coisa;
  • Temos foco e somos obcecados por priorização e eficiência;
  • Tratamos adultos como adultos, com autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Somos transparentes e não-hierárquicos;
  • Nos preocupamos genuinamente com as nossas pessoas;

Missão do Cargo

Num contexto de forte crescimento das vendas, gerenciar nossa frota agregada, assegurando profissionalismo, eficiência e disponibilidade dos motoristas.

A área de transporte tem um papel essencial dentro da Clubbi, impactando a experiência dos nossos clientes no momento da entrega, e garantindo nosso crescimento por meio da captação e desenvolvimento de novos motoristas.

A área de transporte também é responsável pelo transporte first mile, dos nossos fornecedores até o nosso armazém.

  • Supervisionar e coordenar equipes de manutenção mecânica, assegurando a execução segura e eficiente das atividades corretivas, preventivas e preditivas.

  • Assegurar o cumprimento das normas de segurança, saúde e meio ambiente (SMS), procedimentos corporativos e regulamentações aplicáveis ao ambiente offshore.
  • Apoiar investigações de falhas, análises de causa raiz (RCA) e implementação de ações corretivas e preventivas.
  • Gerenciarcontratose atividades de empresas terceirizadas, garantindo conformidade técnica, prazos, qualidade e segurança dos serviços executados.
  • Desenvolver tecnicamente a equipe, promovendotreinamentos, padronização de boas práticas e melhoria contínua dos processos de manutenção.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

- Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;

-Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;

-Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!

-Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

QIMA Life Sciences is looking for a Marketing Project Leader – Brazil to join our Marketing team. We are seeking a scientifically driven professional, eager to grow into a strategic role at the crossroads of marketing, scientific communication, and business development.

  • Autonomous and proactive, capable of driving a market segment.

  • Contribuir para o bom relacionamento com doadores, atendendo às demandas da Diretoria de Relações Institucionais no trabalho de fundraising e nas demandas pontuais de financiadores.
  • Pesquisar e redigir documentos técnicos, artigos, sínteses e destaques para divulgação em mídias, eventos, imprensa, financiadores e parceiros, com foco em política climática, economia do clima e finanças climáticas.

Modelo de Contratação

CLT

SOBRE O ICS (Instituto de Clima e Sociedade)

O Instituto Clima e Sociedade (iCS) é uma organização filantrópica que promove prosperidade, justiça e desenvolvimento de baixo carbono no Brasil. Funcionamos como uma ponte entre financiadores internacionais e nacionais e parceiros locais. Assim, somos parte de uma ampla rede de organizações filantrópicas dedicadas à construção de soluções para a crise climática. O iCS traça planos de ação frente aos problemas climáticos a partir de uma lente social. Por isso, prioriza medidas que, além de reduzir as emissões de gases de efeito estufa (GEE), também gerem melhorias na qualidade de vida para a sociedade, em especial para os mais vulneráveis. A atividade principal do Instituto é dar doações para fomentar projetos e organizações que visem:

  • CONSTRUIR evidências que qualifiquem o debate e apoiem a tomada de decisão
  • PROMOVER advocacy, campanhas e comunicação
  • CRIAR espaços de interação entre diversos atores e setores
  • INCENTIVAR o intercâmbio de conhecimento e experiência entre o Brasil e o mundo

Além disso, também nos dedicamos ao engajamento da sociedade com o tema de mudanças climáticas, implementação de projetos próprios e capacitação institucional de organizações da sociedade civil.
